policy.player_profiles: current first-team team_id only; no B/reserve/youth team profiles
policy.historical_participants: non-first-team-assigned players retained only on individual first-team match rows where they logged minutes; no full profile or reserve data
policy.player_season_stats: tracked players, first-team team_id rows only
policy.player_match_stats: all retained first-team roster match-sheet rows; non-first-team guests only on exact rows where they logged minutes
policy.fixtures: all first-team fixtures, including scheduled fixtures; opponent identity/date/venue/competition/score metadata only
policy.team_match_stats: only the managed first team's own team row
policy.opponent_data: identity and match context only; no opponent player profiles or opponent team-performance rows

notes: players.json contains only records whose current team_id is the managed first-team ID.
Reserve/youth players who logged minutes remain identifiable only on those exact first-team match-history rows; their full profiles and reserve-team data are excluded.
Reserve/youth match-sheet rows without actual minutes are removed individually, even for a guest who appeared in another first-team match.
Opponent identity, venue, date, competition and score remain as match context.
The .fm save is never modified; only generated export files are filtered.
